```{=html}
<script>
(function() {
  // Configuration
  const RESULT_COLORS = {
    'Accept': 'accept',
    'Minor Revision': 'minor',
    'Major Revision': 'major',
    'Reject': 'reject'
  };
  
  const RESULT_CLASS = {
    'Accept': 'active-accept',
    'Minor Revision': 'active-minor',
    'Major Revision': 'active-major',
    'Reject': 'active-reject'
  };
  
  let allReviews = [];
  let currentDisplayYear = new Date().getFullYear(); 
  let minYear = currentDisplayYear;
  let maxYear = currentDisplayYear;
  let reviewCache = {};

  function parseDate(dateStr) { return new Date(dateStr); }
  
  function formatDate(date) {
    return date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
  }
  
  function daysBetween(date1, date2) {
    const oneDay = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
    return Math.round(Math.abs((date2 - date1) / oneDay));
  }
  
  function getDatesInRange(startDate, endDate) {
    const dates = [];
    let current = new Date(startDate);
    const end = new Date(endDate);
    while (current <= end) {
      dates.push(new Date(current));
      current.setDate(current.getDate() + 1);
    }
    return dates;
  }
  
  function dateKey(date) {
    return `${date.getFullYear()}-${String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  }
  
  async function loadReviewData() {
    try {
      const response = await fetch('review-data.json');
      const data = await response.json();
      return data.reviews || [];
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error loading review data:', error);
      return [];
    }
  }

  function buildDataCache(reviews) {
    reviewCache = {}; 
    
    reviews.forEach(review => {
      const endDateStr = dateKey(parseDate(review.end_date));
      const datesInRange = getDatesInRange(parseDate(review.start_date), parseDate(review.end_date));
      
      if (!reviewCache[endDateStr]) {
        reviewCache[endDateStr] = { endReviews: [], overlappingReviews: [] };
      }
      reviewCache[endDateStr].endReviews.push(review);

      datesInRange.forEach(date => {
        const dKey = dateKey(date);
        if (!reviewCache[dKey]) {
          reviewCache[dKey] = { endReviews: [], overlappingReviews: [] };
        }
        reviewCache[dKey].overlappingReviews.push(review);
      });
    });
  }

  function buildReviewWall(reviews, targetYear) {
    const wall = document.getElementById('review-wall');
    if (!wall) return;
    
    wall.innerHTML = '';
    
    let minDate = new Date(targetYear, 0, 1);
    let maxDate = new Date(targetYear, 11, 31);
    minDate.setDate(minDate.getDate() - minDate.getDay());
    
    // Generate weeks
    const current = new Date(minDate);
    
    while (current <= maxDate) {
      const weekCol = document.createElement('div');
      weekCol.className = 'week-column';
      
      for (let day = 0; day < 7; day++) {
        const cell = document.createElement('div');
        cell.className = 'day-cell';
        const id = dateKey(current);
        cell.dataset.id = id;
        
        if (current.getFullYear() !== targetYear) {
          cell.classList.add('out-of-year'); 
        }

        const key = dateKey(current);
        
        const cacheData = reviewCache[id];
        if (cacheData && cacheData.endReviews.length > 0) {
          const review = cacheData.endReviews[0];
          cell.classList.add(RESULT_CLASS[review.result]);
        }
        
        cell.addEventListener('mouseenter', handleMouseEnter);
        cell.addEventListener('mouseleave', handleMouseLeave);
        cell.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
        
        weekCol.appendChild(cell);
        current.setDate(current.getDate() + 1);
      }
      wall.appendChild(weekCol);
    }
  }

  function updateDashboard() {
    const yearLabel = document.getElementById('current-year-label');
    if (yearLabel) yearLabel.textContent = currentDisplayYear;

    const prevBtn = document.getElementById('prev-year-btn');
    const nextBtn = document.getElementById('next-year-btn');
    if (prevBtn) prevBtn.disabled = currentDisplayYear <= minYear;
    if (nextBtn) nextBtn.disabled = currentDisplayYear >= maxYear;

    const currentYearReviews = allReviews.filter(r => {
        const startY = parseDate(r.start_date).getFullYear();
        const endY = parseDate(r.end_date).getFullYear();
        return startY <= currentDisplayYear && endY >= currentDisplayYear;
    });

    buildReviewWall(allReviews, currentDisplayYear); 
    buildReviewList(currentYearReviews); 
    updateStats(currentYearReviews);   
  }

  function setupNavigation() {
    const prevBtn = document.getElementById('prev-year-btn');
    const nextBtn = document.getElementById('next-year-btn');

    if (prevBtn) {
      prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (currentDisplayYear > minYear) {
          currentDisplayYear--;
          updateDashboard();
        }
      });
    }

    if (nextBtn) {
      nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (currentDisplayYear < maxYear) {
          currentDisplayYear++;
          updateDashboard();
        }
      });
    }
  }
  
  function handleMouseEnter(e) {
    const cell = e.target;
    const id = cell.dataset.id; // 获取 ID
    const date = parseDate(id);
    const tooltip = document.getElementById('review-tooltip');
    tooltip.querySelector('.tooltip-title').textContent = formatDate(date);
    
    const cacheData = reviewCache[id] || { endReviews: [], overlappingReviews: [] };
    
    if (cacheData.endReviews.length > 0) {
      let infoHtml = '';
      cacheData.endReviews.forEach(review => {
        const start_date = parseDate(review.start_date);
        const end_date = parseDate(review.end_date);
        const duration = daysBetween(start_date, end_date);
        const badgeClass = RESULT_COLORS[review.result];
        
        // 动态生成每一行的 HTML 结构
        infoHtml += `
          <div class="tooltip-review-line">
            <span class="tooltip-journal">${review.journal} <span class="tooltip-duration">(${duration} days)</span></span>
            <span class="tooltip-result ${badgeClass}">${review.result}</span>
          </div>
        `;
      });
      
      // 4. 插入多行内容
      tooltip.querySelector('.tooltip-info').innerHTML = infoHtml;
      cacheData.endReviews.forEach(review => {
        highlightDateRange(review.start_date, review.end_date, true);
      });
      tooltip.classList.add('visible');
    } else if (cacheData.overlappingReviews.length > 0) {
      
      const reviewing = cacheData.overlappingReviews; 
      tooltip.querySelector('.tooltip-title').textContent += " reviewing";
      tooltip.querySelector('.tooltip-info').innerHTML = reviewing.map(x => x.journal).join("<br/>");
      tooltip.classList.add('visible');
    } else {
      tooltip.querySelector('.tooltip-info').textContent = 'No review activity';
      tooltip.classList.add('visible');
    }
  }
  
  function handleMouseLeave(e) {
    const cell = e.target;
    const id = cell.dataset.id;
    const tooltip = document.getElementById('review-tooltip');
    
    const cacheData = reviewCache[id] || { endReviews: [], overlappingReviews: [] };
    
    // 取消高亮
    if (cacheData.endReviews.length > 0) {
      cacheData.endReviews.forEach(review => {
        highlightDateRange(review.start_date, review.end_date, false);
      });
    }
    
    tooltip.classList.remove('visible');
  }
  
  function handleMouseMove(e) { 
    const tooltip = document.getElementById('review-tooltip');
    const x = e.clientX + 15;
    const y = e.clientY + 15;
    const rect = tooltip.getBoundingClientRect();
    const finalX = x + rect.width > window.innerWidth ? x - rect.width - 30 : x;
    const finalY = y + rect.height > window.innerHeight ? y - rect.height - 30 : y;
    tooltip.style.left = finalX + 'px';
    tooltip.style.top = finalY + 'px';
  }
  
  function highlightDateRange(startDate, endDate, highlight) { 
    const cells = document.querySelectorAll('.day-cell');
    const start = dateKey(parseDate(startDate));
    const end = dateKey(parseDate(endDate));
    
    cells.forEach(cell => {
      const cellDate = cell.dataset.id;
      if (cellDate >= start && cellDate <= end) {
        if (highlight) {
          cell.classList.add('in-range');
          if (cellDate === start) cell.classList.add('range-start');
          if (cellDate === end) cell.classList.add('range-end');
        } else {
          cell.classList.remove('in-range', 'range-start', 'range-end');
        }
      }
    });
  }
  
  function buildReviewList(reviews) {
    const container = document.getElementById('review-list-container');
    if (!container) return;
    container.innerHTML = '';
    
    const sorted = [...reviews].sort((a, b) => parseDate(b.end_date) - parseDate(a.end_date));
    
    if (sorted.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = '<div class="no-reviews">No review activity in this year.</div>';
        return;
    }

    sorted.forEach(review => {
      const item = document.createElement('div');
      item.className = 'review-item';
      const startDate = parseDate(review.start_date);
      const endDate = parseDate(review.end_date);
      const duration = daysBetween(startDate, endDate);
      
      item.innerHTML = `
        <div class="review-date-badge">
          <div class="review-date">${formatDate(endDate)}</div>
          <span class="review-result-badge ${RESULT_COLORS[review.result]}">${review.result}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="review-content">
          <div class="review-journal">${review.journal}</div>
          <div class="review-paper-title">"${review.paper_title}"</div>
          <div class="review-duration">📅 ${formatDate(startDate)} → ${formatDate(endDate)} · ${duration} days</div>
        </div>
      `;
      container.appendChild(item);
    });
  }
  
  function updateStats(reviews) {
    const counts = { 'Accept': 0, 'Minor Revision': 0, 'Major Revision': 0, 'Reject': 0 };
    reviews.forEach(r => {
      if (counts[r.result] !== undefined) counts[r.result]++;
    });
    
    const totalEl = document.querySelector('.stat-number.total');
    const acceptEl = document.querySelector('.stat-number.accept');
    const minorEl = document.querySelector('.stat-number.minor');
    const majorEl = document.querySelector('.stat-number.major');
    const rejectEl = document.querySelector('.stat-number.reject');
    
    if (totalEl) totalEl.textContent = reviews.length;
    if (acceptEl) acceptEl.textContent = counts['Accept'];
    if (minorEl) minorEl.textContent = counts['Minor Revision'];
    if (majorEl) majorEl.textContent = counts['Major Revision'];
    if (rejectEl) rejectEl.textContent = counts['Reject'];
  }
  
  async function init() {
    allReviews = await loadReviewData();
    
    if (allReviews.length > 0) {
      buildDataCache(allReviews);
      allReviews.forEach(r => {
        const startY = parseDate(r.start_date).getFullYear();
        const endY = parseDate(r.end_date).getFullYear();
        if (startY < minYear) minYear = startY;
        if (endY > maxYear) maxYear = endY;
      });
    }

    setupNavigation();
    updateDashboard(); 
  }
  
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();
</script>
```
